about: Duck Live emotion clips. Built by app/tools/make_animations.py; do not edit by hand.

clips.name: hello
clips.label: Hello
clips.description: Looks at you, tilts its head one way then the other on two cheerful quacks, and nods.

clips.name: happy
clips.label: Happy
clips.description: Wiggles on the spot (the walk policy turning left-right), chirps climbing in pitch, then jumps for joy (the jump policy).

clips.name: dance
clips.label: Dance
clips.description: Side-steps left and right on a beat (the walk policy's lateral command), bobs its head and sings an eight-note tune.

clips.name: sing
clips.label: Sing
clips.description: Beak up, sways and sings a ten-note phrase; the beak follows every note.

clips.name: love
clips.label: Love
clips.description: Looks at you, then goes shy: head tilted and turned away, a slow sway on two soft coos, and a peek back.

clips.name: proud
clips.label: Proud
clips.description: Beak high on a two-note fanfare, then looks slowly over its audience.

clips.name: showoff
clips.label: Show off
clips.description: 'Watch this': two quacks, a front flip (the front-flip policy), then the proud pose and its fanfare.

clips.name: peck
clips.label: Peck
clips.description: Head down to the floor, three pecks with a beak click each, then beak up to swallow with a content hum.

clips.name: yawn
clips.label: Yawn
clips.description: A long yawn: the beak opens wide as the head tips back, then it droops, drowsy, and shakes itself awake.

clips.name: sneeze
clips.label: Sneeze
clips.description: 'Ah... ah...': the head tips back in two steps, then snaps down on the sneeze and shakes it off.

clips.name: startled
clips.label: Startled
clips.description: Head snaps back with an alarm call, a quick step backwards (the walk policy), looks left and right, then creeps forward.

clips.name: dizzy
clips.label: Shake off
clips.description: A fast decaying head shake with a 'brrr', then a short 'ha'. Plays by itself after the duck has got up from a fall.

clips.name: nap
clips.label: Nap
clips.description: Sits down (the sit-stand policy), the head sinks and it snores twice. It stays seated; S or an arrow wakes it.

clips.name: yes
clips.description: One clear nod with one quack that falls three semitones.
clips.label: Yes

clips.name: no
clips.description: One head shake with a two-note 'no-ah'. Three voicings: pick one at random.
clips.label: No

clips.name: mmh
clips.description: 'What do you mean?': a small head tilt held for a second with a muffled rising 'mmh?'.
clips.label: Mmh?

clips.name: curious
clips.description: 'What? what?': the head comes forward and tilts one way, then the other, on two rising chirps.
clips.label: Curious

clips.name: laugh
clips.description: Beak up, the head wagging with a body dip on every 'ha': one long 'haaa', then seven short ones dying out.
clips.label: Laugh

clips.name: excited
clips.description: Six faster and faster head swings with a body bob on each, and a run of quacks climbing in pitch.
clips.label: Excited

clips.name: angry
clips.description: Beak-up glare, then four head snaps with a hard bark on each and a small body pulse. Two voicings.
clips.label: Angry

clips.name: sad
clips.description: Standing, the head droops while a low coo glides down with it, two slow silent head shakes, then back up.
clips.label: Sad

clips.name: mock
clips.description: 'Gnagnagnagna': beak up, the head rolling side to side on a staccato mocking run.
clips.label: Mock

clips.name: defiant
clips.description: 'Says who?': beak up to its left with a curt quack, then up to its right with a second one.
clips.label: Defiant

clips.name: impatient
clips.description: 'Come on!': four quick head shakes with a body bob each, then the beak flicks up on a huff.
clips.label: Impatient

clips.name: yes_fast
clips.description: The same nod with a curt 'wak'.
clips.label: Yep

clips.name: devastated
clips.description: Sits down at once with an alarmed call, the head droops and shakes three times on three sobs, then comes back level. It stays seated.
clips.label: Devastated

clips.name: play_dead
clips.description: Alarm call while the head whips to the side and the duck sits, then it goes limp, rolls onto its back and lifts its legs, with a dying quack. Needs a mat.

pose_joints.note: Absolute joint angles in radians (not deltas). Joints in torque_off hang free; the joints listed in targets ramp linearly from where they are over ramp_s at servo P gain `gain` (160 = the standing value) and hold; the others hold. The balance policy is off from the first stage on.

stages.what: legs straight: the seated duck rolls flat onto its back

clips.label: Play dead
